headline: New South Wales Health Declares Major Incident Over Cyber Breach
summary: Police are investigating a major cybersecurity breach at NSW Health, though officials confirmed that patient data has not been compromised.
why: Cybersecurity incidents in public health infrastructure expose vulnerabilities in government IT systems and can result in significant operational disruption.
